text.text: One of the four Wizard Armor pieces. All four (hat / robe / leggings / boots) are built the same way: at the Tinkers' Anvil from plating + maille + robe lace, consuming one magic cloth as well.

Armor value comes from the material in the plating slot; the other parts add durability and their own armor traits, so every piece can mix materials freely. Every piece carries the same three exclusive traits (no levels, independent of materials): Mana Surge, Mana Shield and All Paths Are One - they live in the tool definition, so washing a trait off with a modifier crystal removes its bonus.
All four share one 16x16 station pattern, tinkersnewlife:wizard_armor - it is what the station layout draws when you pick the Wizard Armor at the Tinkers' Anvil.

properties: Parts: chestplate plating + maille + robe lace, plus 1 magic cloth
Built-in traits: Mana Surge, Mana Shield, All Paths Are One
Station pattern: tinkersnewlife:wizard_armor (shared by all four)
